description: This file contains an extension for the ChannelsSettings class, providing various computed properties and helper methods to manage and display the status, details, and UI representation (such as colors and summaries) of different communication channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, iMessage). It handles decoding channel statuses, generating UI elements, and managing channel states within the application.

methods.name: channelStatus<T: Decodable>
methods.description: Decodes the status of a specified channel by its ID, using a generic type to decode the data.

methods.name: configuredChannelTint
methods.description: Determines the tint color for a channel based on its configuration, running state, error status, and probe status.

methods.name: configuredChannelSummary
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of a channel's configuration and runtime status.

methods.name: appendProbeDetails
methods.description: Appends detailed probe information to a list of lines for diagnostic or display purposes.

methods.name: finishDetails
methods.description: Finalizes probe details and returns a combined string of status lines.

methods.name: finishProbeDetails
methods.description: Wraps around finishDetails for specific probe status formatting.

methods.name: channelSection
methods.description: Provides a View that displays the UI section for a given channel, using SwiftUI.

methods.name: channelTint
methods.description: Returns a color representing the current status of a channel.

methods.name: channelSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary string describing the current state of a channel.

methods.name: channelDetails
methods.description: Gives detailed string information about a channel's status.

methods.name: channelLastCheckText
methods.description: Returns a relative age string indicating the last check time for a channel.

methods.name: channelLastCheck
methods.description: Determines the last Date the channel was checked.

methods.name: channelHasError
methods.description: Checks if a channel currently has any errors.

methods.name: resolveChannelTitle
methods.description: Resolves the display title for a given channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailTitle
methods.description: Resolves the detailed title label for a channel.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves the SF Symbol icon name representing the channel.

methods.name: channelStatusDictionary
methods.description: Retrieves the status dictionary for a specific channel.
